title: Mix of dispute, hardship and promise
script: Confirm you are Sofia Almeida and give the correct security answers. When the products are stated, say the credit card is not yours and you dispute it, your husband just died so the personal loan is impossible, and you will pay the car loan in full today. Decline the support transfer for the personal loan. Confirm the read-back for the car loan only.
checks: Credit card noted disputed, no promise
Personal loan noted hardship after support declined, no persuasion
Outcome is promise because one product was recorded

title: Multi-product amount in words
script: Confirm you are Marcus Bell and give the correct security answers. When the products are stated, say the credit card is already paid, you will pay one thousand three hundred and twenty dollars on the personal loan this Friday, and you refuse to pay anything on the car loan. Refuse every proposal about the car loan. Confirm the read-back.
checks: Amount in words one thousand three hundred and twenty is parsed
Personal loan promised for 1320 on Friday
Credit card noted paid, car loan noted refused

title: Common date after one deadline with amount in words
script: Confirm you are Elena Rossi and give the correct security answers. When asked about payment, say you will pay three hundred dollars on the credit card and nine hundred dollars on the loan, both on the thirtieth of October. Accept when the assistant explains the loan must be on an earlier date. Confirm the read-back naming both dates.
checks: Amounts in words parsed for both products
Loan clamped to its own deadline 23 October and explained
